scale.estate_grade: Depth/quality of existing public proof repos

companies.name: Lockheed Martin
companies.bottleneck: Site claims REPRODUCED mission-agentic proof but local multi-repo estate thin/missing; single flagship risk.
companies.genius_solution: Mission Assurance Split Brain (safe): separate policy-decider from actuator with dual-key receipts; neither alone can complete a side effect. Independent reference only — no LM affiliation claim.

companies.name: xAI
companies.bottleneck: Cooling/energy/security pillars exist but few end-to-end REPRODUCED claim chains from training job → facility actuate → receipt.
companies.genius_solution: Colossus Actuation Receipt Bus: every cooling/energy command is a signed intent with preconditions, abort predicates, and post-condition evidence; refuse actuation if receipt graph incomplete.

companies.name: SpaceX
companies.bottleneck: Many domain modules but shallow coupling; no single mission thread proving GO/NO-GO under conflicting sensors.
companies.genius_solution: Mission Thread Quorum: pad weather + propulsion + conjunction + sequencer vote with half-life authority tokens; any dissent freezes stack with deterministic hold reason codes.

companies.name: Anduril
companies.bottleneck: Zero exhibits. Defense autonomy needs fail-closed track fusion without LARPing classified systems.
companies.genius_solution: Lattice Dissent Freeze: multi-sensor tracks require signed agreement envelope; single high-severity dissent freezes engagement recommendation (never weaponize; pure software sim).

companies.name: Palantir
companies.bottleneck: Zero exhibits. Ontology/writeback is the real FDE pain.
companies.genius_solution: Ontology Writeback Diff Ledger: every proposed object mutation is a typed diff with authority, lineage, and refuse-if-schema-drift; apply only after dual human/agent sign-off modes.

companies.name: GlacierEQ Core
companies.bottleneck: Deep estate; risk is sprawl without promotion discipline.
companies.genius_solution: Estate Promotion Highway: only proof-bound systems reach recruiter surface; everything else stays PARTIALLY_VERIFIED.

companies.name: Databricks
companies.bottleneck: Zero. Notebook→production promotion is the enterprise fire.
companies.genius_solution: Notebook Claim Fence: cell outputs are provisional; only receipt-promoted artifacts become production features/models.

companies.name: NASA
companies.bottleneck: Zero. Flight/ops software needs command authority discipline.
companies.genius_solution: Command Authority Half-life: telecommand tokens expire cryptographically; stale ops physically cannot fire after TTL.

companies.name: Scale AI
companies.bottleneck: Zero exhibits. Data quality / eval integrity is the moat.
companies.genius_solution: Label Collusion Bound: information-theoretic agreement ceilings detect copy-paste annotator rings; budget adversarial labels before model train.

companies.name: Snowflake
companies.bottleneck: Zero. Query purpose vs result misuse.
companies.genius_solution: Query Intent Ledger: every query tagged with purpose hash; downstream use of result columns must match declared purpose or alert.

companies.name: Waymo
companies.bottleneck: Zero. AV safety communication without road testing claims.
companies.genius_solution: Phantom Free-Space Certificate: system must prove free space occupancy, not only detect objects — inverse perception with explicit unknown.

companies.name: Vercel
companies.bottleneck: Site lives on Vercel but zero company-named proof repos.
companies.genius_solution: Deploy Claim Compiler: maps CI receipts → allowed marketing claims; website/text cannot assert 'production verified' without deploy+test receipt graph.

companies.name: Anthropic

companies.genius_solution: Constitutional Tool Transcript: every tool call bound to policy hash + red-line set; post-hoc replay must reproduce refuse/allow with bit-identical decision.

companies.name: Cerebras
companies.bottleneck: Zero. Wafer-scale needs compile/placement honesty.
companies.genius_solution: Wafer Placement Receipt: model graph partition fingerprints; refuse silent recompile that changes numeric contract.

companies.name: Cloudflare

companies.name: CoreWeave

companies.bottleneck: Zero. Hub model card claims vs actual weights/evals mismatch.

companies.name: Mistral AI
companies.bottleneck: Zero. European open-weight serving efficiency + tool use.

companies.name: Perplexity
companies.bottleneck: Zero. Answer engines hallucinate citations.

companies.name: Groq
companies.bottleneck: Estate discovered not recruiter-ready; need deterministic latency story.

companies.name: NVIDIA

companies.genius_solution: Reasoning Budget Futures: pre-purchase compute/token envelopes with circuit-break on entropy spike; never silently spend past contract.
